question: What is the primary reason why cleaning must happen before sterilization?

options.A: Organic matter protects germs from the sterilization process
options.B: Water makes the instruments softer to handle
options.C: Soap adds a layer of chemical protection
options.D: Washing removes the unpleasant metal smell

explanation: Dried blood and body fluids form a barrier over microorganisms that blocks heat or chemicals from reaching them. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T68#GNS214_U1_T68_h1)

question: Why must instrument cleaning and brushing be done submerged under water?

options.A: To make the detergent foam up much faster
options.B: To prevent infectious droplets from splashing into the air
options.C: To cool down the metal before it gets handled
options.D: To save clean water from running out too quickly

explanation: Scrubbing in the open air creates fine mists that staff can inhale or that can contaminate surrounding sterile surfaces. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T68#GNS214_U1_T68_h1)

question: What equipment provides the gold standard for sterilizing surgical instruments using moist heat?
explanation: The autoclave uses pressurized steam to achieve temperatures high enough to kill bacterial spores effectively. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T68#GNS214_U1_T68_h2)

question: Why must instrument packs inside an autoclave chamber be loosely arranged rather than tightly packed?

options.A: Loose packs dry much faster after the cycle ends
options.B: Tightly packed metal will melt from the intense heat
options.C: Air pockets help the machine reach high pressure quicker
options.D: Steam must circulate freely around every item

explanation: If packs are squeezed together, steam cannot penetrate the center, leaving some instruments unsterilized. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T68#GNS214_U1_T68_h2)

question: Which sterilization method is best suited for sharp surgical blades because it prevents them from dulling?

options.B: Dry heat in a hot air oven
options.D: Cold soaking in mild soap water

explanation: Dry heat does not cause rust or water-related dulling, making it ideal for maintaining the sharp edges of surgical blades. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T68#GNS214_U1_T68_h3)

question: What must be done to heat-sensitive instruments after they undergo chemical cold sterilization?

options.A: Store them immediately inside a sealed plastic bag
options.B: Wipe them dry with an ordinary cloth towel
options.C: Rinse them thoroughly using sterile water
options.D: Heat them briefly over an open spirit flame

explanation: Chemical sterilants are toxic to human tissue and must be washed off with sterile water to prevent chemical burns or irritation. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T68#GNS214_U1_T68_h3)

question: Which monitoring method provides the only true proof that sterilization successfully killed all bacterial spores?
explanation: Biological indicators use actual heat-resistant bacterial spores to verify that the machine successfully destroyed all microbial life. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T68#GNS214_U1_T68_h4)

question: What do chemical indicator strips placed on a sterile pack actually tell the nurse?

options.A: The autoclave machine is fully repaired and working
options.B: The package was exposed to the required temperature or steam
options.C: The instruments inside have no rust or organic debris
options.D: All bacteria inside the pack are completely dead

explanation: Chemical indicators change color to show heat exposure, but they do not guarantee that the required time or conditions killed all germs. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T68#GNS214_U1_T68_h4)

question: A nurse notices that a sterile instrument pack has a small water stain on the outside wrapper. What should the nurse do?

options.A: Open the pack and check if the metal tools feel wet inside
options.B: Use the instruments immediately before the stain gets larger
options.C: Wipe the outer wrapper with alcohol and store it back
options.D: Consider the pack contaminated and send it for re-sterilization

explanation: Moisture compromises the porous paper barrier, allowing bacteria to wick inside and contaminate the contents. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T68#GNS214_U1_T68_h5)

question: What determines when a wrapped sterile instrument pack officially expires and needs re-sterilization?

options.A: The exact number of days marked on the calendar
options.B: Damage, wetness, or a tear in the packaging barrier
options.C: Whether the autoclave machine was washed this week
options.D: The brand name of the paper wrap used by the hospital

explanation: Sterility is event-related; packs stay sterile indefinitely unless the protective packaging is compromised by moisture, dirt, or physical damage. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T68#GNS214_U1_T68_h5)
